description: Ministry of Labour - Appoint New Members of the Wages Board for the Janitorial Service Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the appointment of members to a Wages Board under the Wages Boards Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It establishes a statutory body (the Wages Board) and specifies its composition and duration, falling under legal/regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring. The mention of the Minister of Labor is in the context of exercising statutory powers, not announcing a personnel change.
